description: Google reCAPTCHA v2 between frontend, backend and Google (specification section 7, SR-01, SR-02).

testMode.control: checkbox labelled 'I am not a robot (test mode)'

verifyResponse.rejected: success false or missing, any non-200 status, unparsable body, I/O error or timeout

startupGuard: refuse to start when RECAPTCHA_TEST_MODE=true and APP_ENVIRONMENT is not 'local' or 'test'
refuse to start when RECAPTCHA_TEST_MODE=false and RECAPTCHA_SITE_KEY or RECAPTCHA_SECRET_KEY is empty
